findings.title: Result becomes consequence
findings.claim: The first فَ carries the water-driven sequence into crop emergence, while the closing فَ makes the final perception question consequential.
findings.mechanism: The carrier is فَ before نُخْرِجُ at 32:27:9:1; the earlier directed-water clause and the later question prefix at 32:27:16:2 are independent triggers. Their repeated result force connects material production to the demand that its observers perceive what the sequence shows.
findings.reader_payoff: The crop's emergence reads as the material result that grounds the closing demand.
findings.containment: The cited 32:20 contrast is excluded; this claim rests on the two local connectors and does not by itself state the whole surah argument.

epistemic.reason: The focus form, local trigger, and cited evidence directly support this bounded relation.

findings.title: The result connector pivots to emergence
findings.claim: فَ before نُخْرِجُ presents crop emergence as the next result in the sequence that begins with water being driven toward land.
findings.mechanism: The result particle at 32:27:9:1 is the carrier; the preceding water, direction, and receiving land at 32:27:5:2 through 32:27:7:2 trigger its consequential force. Contact between the directed input and the following causative verb makes emergence part of one chain rather than an unrelated event.
findings.reader_payoff: The crop is encountered as the next stage of the water-to-land process.
findings.containment: The connector supplies sequence and result; the agent and instrument are established by the surrounding forms, not by فَ alone.

epistemic.reason: The focus form, local trigger, and cited evidence directly support this bounded relation.

findings.title: The speaker brings forth the crop
findings.claim: The first-person plural forms أَنَّا, نَسُوقُ, and نُخْرِجُ keep one speaker as the agent who drives the water and brings the crop out.
findings.mechanism: The 1P suffix in أَنَّا and prefixes in the two verbs carry the agency line; water as object, the receiving land, and the crop as output are independent participants that make the causative relation visible.
findings.reader_payoff: The production scene has a continuous agent across movement and emergence.
findings.containment: The grammar identifies the speaking agent within the verse; it does not specify an agricultural technique or make the crop's ordinary growth disappear.

epistemic.reason: The focus form, local trigger, and cited evidence directly support this bounded relation.

findings.title: Water mediates the crop's emergence
findings.claim: The pronoun in بِهِۦ retrieves the earlier water and marks it as the means through which the speaker brings out زَرْعًا.
findings.mechanism: The instrumental بِهِۦ at 32:27:10:1–2 is the carrier; نُخْرِجُ and its crop object at 32:27:9:2 and 32:27:11:1 trigger the instrumental relation. The water remains active between action and product rather than disappearing after delivery.
findings.reader_payoff: The causal path includes a named medium, not merely a destination followed by growth.
findings.containment: The pronoun's local antecedent is water; no additional substance or mechanism is introduced.

epistemic.reason: The focus form, local trigger, and cited evidence directly support this bounded relation.

findings.title: Stripped land becomes a feeding ground
findings.claim: The locally barren land receives water, yields crop, and becomes the source from which the named consumers eat.
findings.mechanism: The carrier is the condition marked by ٱلْجُرُزِ at 32:27:8:2; the following emergence at 32:27:9:2 through 32:27:11:1 and eating relation at 32:27:12:1 through 32:27:15:2 independently trigger a movement from deprivation to yield and use.
findings.reader_payoff: The verse's land is read through the change that follows its stripped condition.
findings.containment: The 48:29 comparison is excluded; the reversal here is supported by the local sequence, not by an imported comparison.

epistemic.reason: The focus form, local trigger, and cited evidence directly support this bounded relation.

findings.title: The crop is left indefinite
findings.claim: The indefinite زَرْعًا presents crop output without naming a particular species, allowing the provision scene to remain general.
findings.mechanism: The indefinite crop noun at 32:27:11:1 is the carrier; the water-mediated emergence and the plural consumers at 32:27:12:1 through 32:27:15:2 trigger the generic reading of yield that can serve the named beneficiaries.
findings.reader_payoff: The proof concerns reproducible provision rather than a single named harvest.
findings.containment: Indefiniteness generalizes the crop; it does not claim that every kind of plant or every harvest is included.

epistemic.reason: The focus form, local trigger, and cited evidence directly support this bounded relation.

findings.title: Eating makes the crop continuing sustenance
findings.claim: The imperfect تَأْكُلُ depicts ongoing consumption from the crop, while its base feminine-singular form keeps the collective livestock parse available and the supplied masculine variant remains visible as bounded pressure.
findings.mechanism: The verb at 32:27:12:1 is the carrier; مِنْهُ retrieves the crop as source and the coordinated beneficiaries supply the eating relation. The base form and variant affect how the subject relation is heard, but neither cancels the ordinary eating scene.
findings.reader_payoff: The crop becomes continuing intake, while the variant keeps a grammatical alternative in view without displacing the base parse.
findings.containment: The canonical feminine-singular form remains the local surface; the masculine variant is retained as a qualified alternative, not selected as the governing reading.

epistemic.reason: The local carrier is supported, while a variant or source/provenance qualification remains visible and unranked.

findings.title: Crop becomes the beneficiaries' sustenance
findings.claim: The crop is not only brought out; it is consumed by the livestock and human selves named in the same clause.
findings.mechanism: The crop and its retrieving pronoun at 32:27:11:1 and 32:27:13:2 are the carrier; the eating verb and coordinated beneficiaries at 32:27:12:1 and 32:27:14:1 through 32:27:15:2 trigger the shift from product to ongoing sustenance.
findings.reader_payoff: Production reaches its narrated human and animal use.
findings.containment: The clause says who eats from this crop; it does not claim that consumption exhausts the whole yield.

epistemic.reason: The focus form, local trigger, and cited evidence directly support this bounded relation.

findings.title: The preposition points back to the crop
findings.claim: مِنْهُ makes the crop the source from which the named consumers eat, with source and possible partitive force held together.
findings.mechanism: The preposition and 3MS pronoun at 32:27:13:1–2 are the carrier; the eating verb and its antecedent crop at 32:27:12:1 and 32:27:11:1 trigger the reference. The contact keeps the crop as the eating source without adding an unstated object.
findings.reader_payoff: The produced crop remains the material source of the feeding relation.
findings.containment: The phrase can carry source and portion nuances; neither requires a second, unexpressed object.

epistemic.reason: The focus form, local trigger, and cited evidence directly support this bounded relation.

findings.title: Livestock are named as the first eaters
findings.claim: The clause names أَنْعَٰمُهُمْ as the first explicit eating subject, before adding human selves under the same verb.
findings.mechanism: The carrier is the verb-first order with its feminine-singular imperfect at 32:27:12:1 and the following livestock noun at 32:27:14:1; وَ at 32:27:15:1 independently adds human selves to the already established eating relation.
findings.reader_payoff: Animal consumption is part of the verse's stated provision, not an incidental afterthought.
findings.containment: The order is local emphasis; it does not establish an absolute hierarchy between animals and people.

epistemic.reason: The focus form, local trigger, and cited evidence directly support this bounded relation.

findings.title: Their own livestock benefit
findings.claim: The possessive suffix on أَنْعَٰمُهُمْ ties the livestock that eat from the crop to the group being challenged by the opening question.
findings.mechanism: The suffix at 32:27:14:2 is the carrier; the same group's question frame and the crop-eating relation at 32:27:1:1 through 32:27:2:2 and 32:27:11:1 through 32:27:14:1 connect the sign to benefits they themselves receive.
findings.reader_payoff: The provision scene concerns creatures belonging to the questioned group.
findings.containment: Possession links the herd to them; it does not by itself establish ownership arrangements or a judgment about their response.

epistemic.reason: The focus form, local trigger, and cited evidence directly support this bounded relation.

findings.title: One conjunction joins distinct consumers
findings.claim: وَ adds human selves after livestock while keeping both under one eating verb and one crop source.
findings.mechanism: The conjunction at 32:27:15:1 is the carrier; the already named livestock and shared eating predicate at 32:27:12:1 and 32:27:14:1 independently trigger coordination. The new noun is distinct, but the feeding relation remains common.
findings.reader_payoff: The verse joins human and animal consumption without collapsing the two groups.
findings.containment: Shared syntax does not mean identical status, need, or role.

epistemic.reason: The focus form, local trigger, and cited evidence directly support this bounded relation.

findings.title: The fed selves are also asked to perceive
findings.claim: The selves sustained by the crop are the same group addressed by the closing demand to perceive the process.
findings.mechanism: أَنْفُسُهُمْ at 32:27:15:2 is the carrier; the immediately following interrogative and perception verb at 32:27:16:1 through 32:27:17:1 trigger the change from beneficiaries to responsible observers.
findings.reader_payoff: Material dependence and the demand for recognition meet in the same persons.
findings.containment: Being fed is not itself proof of insight; the verse still poses perception as a question.

epistemic.reason: The focus form, local trigger, and cited evidence directly support this bounded relation.

findings.title: Their selves are fed collectively and personally
findings.claim: The plural noun أَنْفُسُهُمْ distributes the benefit across the group's own persons while keeping them joined as one coordinated set of consumers.
findings.mechanism: The broken plural and possessive suffix at 32:27:15:2–3 are the carrier; the conjunction and shared eating verb at 32:27:12:1 and 32:27:15:1 connect individual persons to one collective feeding relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The wording lets personal bodies and the group beneficiary remain visible together.
findings.containment: The plural does not turn the phrase into an abstract claim about every inner dimension of the self.

epistemic.reason: The focus form, local trigger, and cited evidence directly support this bounded relation.

findings.title: The ayah is ringed by two challenges
findings.claim: The opening أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ and closing أَفَلَا يُبْصِرُونَ frame the provision sequence between two perception questions.
findings.mechanism: The opening interrogative at 32:27:1:1 through 32:27:2:1 and closing question at 32:27:16:1 through 32:27:17:1 are the carriers; the intervening water-to-crop sequence independently supplies the evidence framed by both. The questions turn the middle scene into proof under demand.
findings.reader_payoff: The agricultural sequence reads as the evidence between an opening and a closing challenge.
findings.containment: The 32:26 hearing comparison is excluded; the local ring stands without the neighboring ayah.

epistemic.reason: The focus form, local trigger, and cited evidence directly support this bounded relation.

findings.title: The closing question makes provision answerable
findings.claim: After water is driven, crop is brought out, and consumers are fed, the final negative question turns the narrated provision into a demand for recognition.
findings.mechanism: The closing hamza, fa, and negation at 32:27:16:1–3 are the carrier; the completed causal chain at 32:27:4:1 through 32:27:15:2 is the independent trigger. The consequential connector makes perception follow from what has just been shown.
findings.reader_payoff: The verse ends by asking what the visible process calls its observers to recognize.
findings.containment: The question creates accountability without claiming that the provision failed or that one response is already proven.

epistemic.reason: The focus form, local trigger, and cited evidence directly support this bounded relation.

findings.title: The opening question places the scene under examination
findings.claim: The opening negative question presents the coming water-and-crop sequence as something the challenged group is asked to see.
findings.mechanism: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ at 32:27:1:1 through 32:27:2:2 is the carrier; the content clause and ensuing directed provision sequence at 32:27:3:1 through 32:27:15:2 independently specify what is placed before their sight.
findings.reader_payoff: The sign is framed as evidence from the outset, before its agricultural details unfold.
findings.containment: The 32:26 comparison is excluded; the focus ayah's opening challenge and its own content are sufficient.

epistemic.reason: The focus form, local trigger, and cited evidence directly support this bounded relation.

findings.title: The closing negation rebukes nonrecognition
findings.claim: The final أَفَلَا question challenges a failure to perceive an already narrated provision chain, rather than reporting a failure of the provision itself.
findings.mechanism: The closing interrogative and laa at 32:27:16:1–3 carry the negative challenge; the specific visible sequence at 32:27:4:1 through 32:27:15:2 independently grounds what remains unrecognized.
findings.reader_payoff: The rebuke attaches to how the observers read the sign, not to whether crops appeared.
findings.containment: The question leaves their response open; it does not assert what every hearer has or has not understood.

epistemic.reason: The focus form, local trigger, and cited evidence directly support this bounded relation.

findings.title: The final verb gathers the whole sequence
findings.claim: Because يُبْصِرُونَ has no explicit object, the closing demand can reach back across the full water-to-consumption chain rather than one isolated item.
findings.mechanism: The objectless final verb at 32:27:17:1 is the carrier; the long sequence of water, land, emergence, crop, and consumers at 32:27:4:1 through 32:27:15:2 independently supplies its scope.
findings.reader_payoff: The closing word gathers the scene into one object of attention.
findings.containment: The broad scope is a local syntactic inference; it does not make every detail an independent proof.

epistemic.reason: The focus form, local trigger, and cited evidence directly support this bounded relation.

findings.title: The final seeing verb closes the local perception loop
findings.claim: The closing perception verb answers the opening seeing verb, moving the reader from the sign to the demanded recognition of its sequence.
findings.mechanism: The opening يَرَوْا۟ at 32:27:2:1 and closing يُبْصِرُونَ at 32:27:17:1 are the carriers; the intervening causal process independently triggers the shift from looking at a scene to apprehending what it shows.
findings.reader_payoff: The ayah closes the perception frame it opened.
findings.containment: The 32:26 hearing contrast is excluded; this is a focus-internal relation, not an imported surah-wide architecture.

epistemic.reason: The focus form, local trigger, and cited evidence directly support this bounded relation.

branch_activations.boundary: This does not infer an entitlement or claim that eating means provision in every context.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: develer ve geniş anlamda otlayan evcil hayvanlar
branch_activations.facet_statement: Dar ve belirgin kullanımda develer veya deve malı.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The same eating verb and the coordinated human selves show the herd's place in the shared chain.
branch_activations.activation: The supplied trace role is “Herd animals supply a nonhuman consumer whose welfare enters the verse before human welfare.” The animal carrier meets the common crop source and later human consumer.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The nonhuman consumers enter before the human ones.
branch_activations.boundary: No absolute animal-first hierarchy is asserted.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: develer ve geniş anlamda otlayan evcil hayvanlar
branch_activations.facet_statement: Geniş topluluk adında deve, sığır ve koyunu kapsayan otlayan evcil hayvanlar.
branch_activations.carrier: أَنْعَٰمُهُمْ names grazing domestic animals in the branch's broader extension.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The crop-eating relation includes both livestock and human selves.
branch_activations.activation: The supplied trace role is “Herd animals supply a nonhuman consumer whose welfare enters the verse before human welfare.” The broader herd category makes the animal side of the shared dependency legible.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The yield sustains livestock beyond a camel-only reading as well as people.
branch_activations.boundary: The extension is preserved with its core facet; the two beneficiary classes remain distinct.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: yaşamı sürdüren, bol ve doyurucu su
branch_activations.facet_statement: Su, yaşamın sürmesini sağlayan temel içecek olarak adlandırılır.
branch_activations.carrier: أَنْفُسُهُمْ continues to mean their own selves/persons.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Water and the eating relation supply an independent life-support trigger.
branch_activations.activation: The supplied trace role is “The sense of water that keeps life going tightens the dependency between the input and living selves.” The branch of life-sustaining water analogically tightens the dependence between the water input and the living selves that consume the crop.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Human beneficiaries are shown as living beings within a water-dependent supply chain.
branch_activations.boundary: The noun is not read as water; the water branch remains an analogy of dependence.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bedene yaşam veren ve bedenden ayrılması ölüm sayılan candır.
branch_activations.carrier: أَنْفُسُهُمْ names living selves/persons.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The eating verb and animals named before them place persons among embodied consumers.
branch_activations.activation: The supplied trace role is “The life-bearing self supplies the human consumer as organism rather than abstract observer.” The life-bearing-self facet meets the human noun's role as a beneficiary rather than only an observer.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Human beings participate as living recipients of provision.
branch_activations.boundary: The word remains selves/persons; no abstract or soul-only sense is imposed.
